in_marathi.name: Dviti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dviti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dviti’, meaning ‘second’ or ‘two’. In Hindu mythology, Dviti represents the second phase of a cycle, symbolizing duality, balance, and harmony.

in_bengali.name: Dviti
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dviti একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dviti’, meaning ‘second’ or ‘two’. In Hindu mythology, Dviti represents the second phase of a cycle, symbolizing duality, balance, and harmony.
